The two numbers at the start of a piece. The top number says how many beats are in each measure, and the bottom number says which note value gets one beat. In 4/4, there are 4 beats and a quarter note gets one.

q: What is the difference between major and minor
a: Major scales and chords usually sound bright and happy. Minor ones usually sound darker or sadder. A major scale has a major 3rd above the starting note, and a minor scale has a minor 3rd.
Staccato means play the note short and detached. Legato means smooth and connected.
